description: Use when an agent must vet or research a website in one call (lead research, security or SEO check, is this site legit). Input: url or bare domain. Output: JSON page metadata, HTTP status, HTTPS and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, server and hosting hints, 7 security headers, robots.txt (sitemaps, AI-crawler rules), llms.txt presence, plus domain DNS, mail provider, SPF/DMARC and RDAP registrar, age and expiry. Example: ?url=stripe.com Price: $0.009 USDC via x402.

url.description: Site URL or bare domain (https:// assumed); private/internal targets → 400 (not charged)
